## 1. Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# CRAN packages
cran_packages <- c(
  "tidyverse",
  "gggenes"
)

to_install <- cran_packages[
  !cran_packages %in% rownames(installed.packages())
]

if (length(to_install) > 0) {
  install.packages(to_install)
}

# Bioconductor packages
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("BiocManager")
}

bioc_packages <- c(
  "Biostrings",
  "pwalign"
)

for (pkg in bioc_packages) {
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
    BiocManager::install(pkg, ask = FALSE)
  }
}

library(tidyverse)
library(gggenes)
library(Biostrings)
library(pwalign)

```

#Function for reading CDS features from GenBank files
```{r}
read_genbank_cds <- function(file, operon_name) {

  x <- readLines(file, warn = FALSE)

  # Find FEATURES and ORIGIN sections
  features_start <- which(grepl("^FEATURES", x))
  origin_start <- which(grepl("^ORIGIN", x))

  if (length(features_start) == 0) {
    stop("No FEATURES section found in ", file)
  }

  if (length(origin_start) == 0) {
    stop("No ORIGIN section found in ", file)
  }

  # Keep annotation lines only
  features <- x[
    (features_start + 1):(origin_start - 1)
  ]

  # Find start of each CDS entry
  cds_starts <- which(
    grepl("^     CDS[[:space:]]+", features)
  )

  if (length(cds_starts) == 0) {
    stop("No CDS features found in ", file)
  }

  cds_ends <- c(
    cds_starts[-1] - 1,
    length(features)
  )

  cds_blocks <- map2(
    cds_starts,
    cds_ends,
    ~ features[.x:.y]
  )

  # Parse one CDS block
  parse_one_cds <- function(block) {

    location <- block[1] |>
      str_remove("^     CDS[[:space:]]+")

    strand <- ifelse(
      str_detect(location, "complement"),
      "-",
      "+"
    )

    coords <- str_extract_all(
      location,
      "[0-9]+"
    )[[1]] |>
      as.numeric()

    if (length(coords) < 2) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    feature_start <- min(coords)
    feature_end <- max(coords)

    qualifiers <- paste(
      block[-1],
      collapse = " "
    ) |>
      str_squish()

    get_qualifier <- function(name) {

      pattern <- paste0(
        "/",
        name,
        "=\"([^\"]*)\""
      )

      result <- str_match(
        qualifiers,
        pattern
      )[, 2]

      ifelse(
        is.na(result),
        NA_character_,
        result
      )
    }

    gene <- get_qualifier("gene")
    product <- get_qualifier("product")
    protein_id <- get_qualifier("protein_id")
    locus_tag <- get_qualifier("locus_tag")

    translation <- str_match(
      qualifiers,
      '/translation="([^"]+)"'
    )[, 2]

    if (!is.na(translation)) {
      translation <- str_replace_all(
        translation,
        "[[:space:]]",
        ""
      )
    }

    tibble(
      operon = operon_name,
      gene = gene,
      locus_tag = locus_tag,
      product = product,
      protein_id = protein_id,
      translation = translation,
      start = feature_start,
      end = feature_end,
      strand = strand
    )
  }

  result <- map_dfr(
    cds_blocks,
    parse_one_cds
  )

  # Use locus tag if gene name is missing
  result <- result |>
    mutate(
      gene = if_else(
        is.na(gene),
        locus_tag,
        gene
      )
    ) |>
    filter(!is.na(gene)) |>
    mutate(
      operon_start = min(start),
      xmin = start - operon_start,
      xmax = end - operon_start,
      forward = strand == "+"
    )

  result
}
```

```{r read-f4}
f4_df <- read_genbank_cds(
  "/Users/xvoast/Documents/Projects/Review_CFs_2026/CF_analyses_R/data/F4.gb",
  "F4"
)

# Inspect all annotated genes on the plasmid
f4_df |>
  dplyr::select(
    gene,
    product,
    protein_id,
    start,
    end,
    strand
  ) |>

  "faeC",
  "faeD",
  "faeE",
  "faeF",
  "faeG",
  "faeH",
  "faeI",
  "faeJ"
)

f4_df <- f4_df |>
  dplyr::filter(gene %in% f4_genes) |>
  dplyr::arrange(start)

# Re-normalize coordinates so the F4 operon starts at position 0
f4_df <- f4_df |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    operon_start = min(start),
    xmin = start - operon_start,
    xmax = end - operon_start,
    forward = strand == "+"
  )

f4_df |>

    gene,
    product,
    protein_id,
    xmin,
    xmax,
    strand
  )
```

```{r}
genes <- dplyr::bind_rows(

p_operons_3 <- ggplot(

    xmin = xmin,
```

#Function for calculating protein sequence identity between CS13 and CS23
```{r}
protein_identity <- function(protein1, protein2) {

  alignment <- pwalign::pairwiseAlignment(
    pattern = protein1,
    subject = protein2,
    type = "global"
  )

  as.numeric(
    pwalign::pid(
      alignment,
      type = "PID1"
    )
  )
}
```

#Calculate all-vs-all protein identities
```{r}
identity_table_CS13_CS23 <- tidyr::crossing(
  cs13_gene = names(cs13_proteins),
  cs23_gene = names(cs23_proteins)
) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    identity = protein_identity(
      cs13_proteins[[cs13_gene]],
      cs23_proteins[[cs23_gene]]
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup()
```

#Inspect all pairwise protein identities
```{r}
identity_table_CS13_CS23 |>
  arrange(
    cs13_gene,
    desc(identity)
  ) |>
  print(n = Inf)
```

#Find the best CS23 match for each CS13 protein
```{r}
best_hits_CS13_CS23 <- identity_table_CS13_CS23 |>
  group_by(cs13_gene) |>
  slice_max(
    order_by = identity,
    n = 1,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  arrange(desc(identity))

best_hits_CS13_CS23
```

#Find reciprocal best matches
```{r}
best_cs23_for_cs13 <- identity_table_CS13_CS23 |>
  group_by(cs13_gene) |>
  slice_max(
    identity,
    n = 1,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) |>
  ungroup()

best_cs13_for_cs23 <- identity_table_CS13_CS23 |>
  group_by(cs23_gene) |>
  slice_max(
    identity,
    n = 1,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) |>
  ungroup()

reciprocal_best_hits_CS23_CS13 <- best_cs23_for_cs13 |>
  inner_join(
    best_cs13_for_cs23,
    by = c(
      "cs13_gene",
      "cs23_gene"
    ),
    suffix = c(
      "_forward",
      "_reverse"
    )
  ) |>
  transmute(
    cs13_gene,
    cs23_gene,
    identity = identity_forward
  )

reciprocal_best_hits_CS23_CS13
```

#Function for calculating protein sequence identity between CS23 and F4
```{r}
protein_identity <- function(protein1, protein2) {

  alignment <- pwalign::pairwiseAlignment(
    pattern = protein1,
    subject = protein2,
    type = "global"
  )

  as.numeric(
    pwalign::pid(
      alignment,
      type = "PID1"
    )
  )
}
```

#Calculate all-vs-all protein identities CS23 vs F4
```{r}
identity_table_CS23_F4 <- tidyr::crossing(
  cs23_gene = names(cs23_proteins),
  f4_gene = names(f4_proteins)
) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    identity = protein_identity(
      cs23_proteins[[cs23_gene]],
      f4_proteins[[f4_gene]]
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup()
```

#Create ribbon polygons
```{r make-ribbons}
# Set y positions manually so we have space between the operons
y_f4   <- 1
y_cs23 <- 2
y_cs13 <- 3

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# CS13 <-> CS23 ribbons
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ribbon_cs13_cs23 <- links_CS13_CS23 |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    link_id = paste0("CS13_CS23_", dplyr::row_number())
  ) |>
  dplyr::rowwise() |>
  do(
    tibble::tibble(
      link_id = .$link_id,
      identity = .$identity,

      x = c(
        .$cs13_xmin,
        .$cs13_xmax,
        .$cs23_xmax,
        .$cs23_xmin
      ),

      # CS13 is at y = 3
      # CS23 is at y = 2
      y = c(
        2.82,
        2.82,
        2.18,
        2.18
      )
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# CS23 <-> F4 ribbons
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ribbon_cs23_f4 <- links_CS23_F4 |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    link_id = paste0("CS23_F4_", dplyr::row_number())
  ) |>
  dplyr::rowwise() |>
  do(
    tibble::tibble(
      link_id = .$link_id,
      identity = .$identity,

      x = c(
        .$cs23_xmin,
        .$cs23_xmax,
        .$f4_xmax,
        .$f4_xmin
      ),

      # CS23 is at y = 2
      # F4 is at y = 1
      y = c(
        1.82,
        1.82,
        1.18,
        1.18
      )
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()


# Combine all ribbons into one dataframe
ribbon_data <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  ribbon_cs13_cs23,
  ribbon_cs23_f4
)

ribbon_data

```

#Plot operons with protein similarity ribbons
```{r plot-operons-with-links, fig.width=12, fig.height=5}
# Give all three operons numeric y coordinates
genes_plot <- genes |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    y_plot = dplyr::case_when(
      operon == "F4"   ~ y_f4,
      operon == "CS23" ~ y_cs23,
      operon == "CS13" ~ y_cs13
    )
  )


p_links <- ggplot() +

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Protein similarity ribbons
  # Draw first so gene arrows sit on top
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  geom_polygon(
    data = ribbon_data,
    aes(
      x = x,
      y = y,
      group = link_id,
      fill = identity
    ),
    alpha = 0.45,
    colour = NA
  ) +


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Gene arrows
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  geom_gene_arrow(
    data = genes_plot,
    aes(
      xmin = xmin,
      xmax = xmax,
      y = y_plot,
      forward = forward
    ),
    fill = "grey85",
    colour = "black",
    arrowhead_height = unit(3, "mm"),
    arrowhead_width = unit(1, "mm")
  ) +


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Gene labels
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  geom_gene_label(
    data = genes_plot,
    aes(
      xmin = xmin,
      xmax = xmax,
      y = y_plot,
      forward = forward,
      label = gene
    ),
    min.size = 2.5,
    grow = TRUE,
    reflow = TRUE
  ) +


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Protein identity scale
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  scale_fill_gradient(
    name = "Protein identity (%)",
    low = "grey90",
    high = "grey20"
  ) +


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Operon labels
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = c(
      y_f4,
      y_cs23,
      y_cs13
    ),
    labels = c(
      "F4",
      "CS23",
      "CS13"
    ),
    limits = c(
      0.7,
      3.3
    )
  ) +


  labs(
    x = "Position within CF locus (bp)",
    y = NULL
  ) +


  theme_minimal(
    base_size = 11
  ) +


  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),

    axis.text.y = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 11
    ),

    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),

    legend.position = "bottom"
  )


p_links
```
